title: 低位内旋膝
description: 赛璐璐风格中，小幅内旋膝帮助身体靠近浅倾角墙面。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original cel-shaded illustration depicts a fictional adult using a restrained drop-knee adjustment on a shallow overhanging bouldering wall. One bent knee turns gently inward while both shoes remain on clearly drawn positive footholds near the continuous crash mat. Large violet handholds provide secure support for a short reach across the body. Avoid forcing the knee into an extreme angle; the pelvis and shoulders turn naturally together. Frame the whole adult in a three-quarter wide view with the wall angle and clear landing area visible. Use clean magenta and turquoise shapes, realistic proportions, and opaque clothing. No jumping, cut-loose feet, lettering, brands, or high exposure.
